title: fix: redirect old pollinations.ai image links to the image API
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Restored the legacy `/p/*` and `/prompt/*` redirects dropped during the move from Netlify to Workers. GET and HEAD requests now receive a 301 to `https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/<prompt>` with the query string preserved, instead of receiving website HTML. `/p`, `/play`, and other routes are unchanged; tests cover both redirect patterns. Cloudflare recorded roughly 112,000 HTML loads per day on `/p/…` and 900 on `/prompt/…`—together about 83% of the site's HTML loads.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, Polli wears a tiny traffic-director hat and guides two winding paths labeled `/p/` and `/prompt/` toward a CRT robot displaying a pixel landscape, with flowers along the paths and prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow against a warm cream and pastel gradient background. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
